newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran hangs three men for seven murders.
newsitem.headline: Iran hangs three men for seven murders.

text.p: Iran hanged three men on Sunday for killing seven people in separate cases, a newspaper said.
The evening daily Kayhan said the three convicted murderers were hanged in a Tehran prison after Iran's Supreme Court upheld their death sentences.
It named the three as Hossein Darvish, Hossein Rahmanipour and Hamid Kuhi and said they had confessed to the murders.

Darvish had shot his aunt and her husband while Rahmanipour had shot to death his wife and daughter as well as her daughter from an earlier marriage and also killed another man, the newspaper said. It did not give the motives for the crimes.
Kuhi had stabbed to death a woman who lived in a building where he worked as a custodian and stolen her property, it added.
